name: Player-Conditional Native Resampling

parent_evidence.interpretation: Fresh post-opponent G/F sampling remains causally justified, while long-horizon evidence does not justify deleting native stochastic variance for every player.

lineage_evidence: INC-20260830-RSMG-PLAYER-STATE:reusing a pre-opponent bundle for post-opponent G/F is semantically invalid
G1-02B:complete e200 had +0.620959 dB late-three mean but -0.001379 dB endpoint after two-replica averaging
G2-01:AM-TNC recovered a positive +0.383135 dB endpoint while retaining stochastic tangent noise, but failed the late LPIPS guardrail
WINNER_ABLATION:PC-RSMG proposal-only separately tests G/F averaging; PCNR removes averaging entirely and retains only the conditionally fresh player transition

compared_implementations: G1-02 invalid shared pre-D RSMG bundle
G1-02B PC-RSMG two-replica D/E and fresh two-replica G/F means
PC-RSMG proposal-only native D/E plus averaged fresh G/F
prior_equivalence_audit.material_difference: PCNR commits exactly one native D/E view, then draws exactly one new native G/F view after D/E commit. It neither averages replicas nor retains an exchange-antisymmetric correction. It removes only the conditional cross-player reuse of randomness, preserves native per-player stochastic variance, and costs two rather than four forward/loss views.

unsb_object: the stochastic coupling of the sequential native D/E opponent transition and the subsequent joint G/F gradient estimator
formula: At full state S_k and official unpaired batch b_k draw one native stochastic view xi_DE. Commit native D and E using xi_DE, producing realized opponent-updated state S_k^{DE}. Discard the view, independently draw one native xi_GF after those commits, and commit joint G/F with g_GF(S_k^{DE},b_k,xi_GF). Thus E[g_GF|S_k^{DE},b_k] is the native conditional field without averaging away its variance. D and E retain their original one-view estimators. Setting pcnr_enable=false dispatches the original SBModel transition exactly.
identity_or_unbiased_condition: For D and E the estimator is the native one-view gradient. Conditional on the realized opponent-updated state S_k^{DE} and official batch, xi_GF is freshly drawn from the native stochastic measure, so E[g_GF(S_k^{DE},b_k,xi_GF)|S_k^{DE},b_k] equals the native conditional expected G/F field. Disabling PCNR is byte-identical to plain. No additional fixed point or loss is introduced.
target_inaccessibility_proof: PCNR reads only the current official unpaired batch and the native latent, time, bridge-noise and PatchNCE randomness. Its event order and one fresh G/F draw are fixed in source. It cannot address discovery pairs, PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, domain labels, plain outputs or confirmation20.

expected_applicable_state.condition: the reused stochastic view is conditionally coupled to the realized D/E state but reducing native per-player noise creates an overly deterministic long-horizon trajectory
expected_applicable_state.self_null_state: pcnr_enable=false is exact plain; when the opponent transition is insensitive to its stochastic view, fresh and reused G/F estimators have the same conditional law
expected_applicable_state.causal_scope: separates conditional player resampling from replica variance reduction and Adam-tangential noise conservation

falsifying_experiment: Kill as mathematically invalid if the event order is not DE_VIEW,D_COMMIT,E_COMMIT,GF_VIEW,GF_COMMIT, if counts do not equal updates, if disabled identity or resume differs from plain, or if the fresh G/F view is drawn before D/E commit. Close only this one-view player-conditional resampling operator if its complete host-matched seed2026 e200 trajectory is negative.
compute_cost: two native batch-1 stochastic forward/loss views per optimizer update: one shared by D/E and one freshly drawn for G/F; optimizer-step count and data exposure remain native
memory_cost: one stochastic view graph at a time; the D/E view is released before the G/F view, so peak activation memory remains near native batch1
recovery_state_cost: update index, two view counters, bundle serial, last event schedule and ordinary optimizer/sampler/RNG state

ablation_definitions.proposal_only: The full PCNR operator: one D/E view followed by one fresh post-opponent G/F view.
ablation_definitions.observable_only: Draw a counterfactual fresh G/F view, restore RNG and tensors, and commit the ordinary native shared-view transition.
ablation_definitions.projected_or_full: Not a projection: use the source-frozen player-conditional one-view resampling transition exactly.

unbiased_proof: D and E use their native one-sample estimators. Given the random opponent state produced by those commits, the later xi_GF draw is independent and distributed exactly as the native stochastic measure. Conditional expectation therefore recovers the native G/F vector field at the state where G/F is actually optimized. Taking total expectation preserves the native per-player expected objectives and stationary conditions while changing only finite-step cross-player noise coupling.
